arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي هَدَانَا لِحَمْدِهِ، وَجَعَلَنَا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، لِنَكُونَ لإحْسَانِهِ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ، وَلِيَجْزِيَنَا عَلَى ذلِكَ جَزَآءَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ.
transliteration: al-ḥamdu lillāh al-ladhī hadānā li-ḥamdihi wa jaʿalnā min ahlīhi, li nakūna li iḥsānihi min al-shākirīn walīyajzīyannā ʿalā dhālika jazāʾa al-muḥsinīn
english_text: Praise belongs to God who guided us to His praise and placed us among the people of praise, that we might be among the thankful for His beneficence and that He might recompense us for that with the recompense of the good-doers!

arabic_text: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي حَبَانَا بِدِينِهِ، وَاخْتَصَّنَا بِمِلَّتِهِ، وَسَبَّلَنَا فِي سُبُلِ إحْسَانِهِ، لِنَسْلُكَهَا بِمَنِّهِ إلَى رِضْوَانِهِ، حَمْدَاً يَتَقَبَّلُهُ مِنَّا، وَيَرْضَى بِهِ عَنَّا.
transliteration: wa al-ḥamdu lillāh alladhī ḥabānā bidīnihī wa-ikhtassanā bi-millatihī, wa-sabbalnā fī subuli-ihsānihī li-naslukahā bi-man-nihi ilā riḍwānihi ḥamdān yataqabbaluhu minnā, wayarḍā bihi ʿannā
english_text: And praise belongs to God who showed favour to us through His religion, singled us out for His creed, and directed us onto the roads of His beneficence, in order that through His kindness we might travel upon them to His good pleasure, a praise which He will accept from us and through which He will be pleased with us!

arabic_text: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّه الَّذِي جَعَلَ مِنْ تِلْكَ السُّبُلِ شَهْرَهُ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ، شَهْرَ الصِّيَامِ، وَشَهْرَ الإِسْلاَم، وَشَهْرَ الطَّهُورِ، وَشَهْرَ التَّمْحِيْصِ، وَشَهْرَ الْقِيَامِ، الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ فِيْهِ الْقُرْآنُ هُدىً لِلنَّاسِ،
transliteration: wal-ḥamdu li-l-lāhi al-laḏī jaʿala min tilka al-subuli shahrahu shahra ramaḍāna shahr al-ṣiyām, wa shahr al-islām, wa shahr al-ṭahūr wa shahra al-tamhīs, wa shahra al-qiyām al-ladhī ʾunzila fīhi al-qurʾān hudan li-l-nās
english_text: And praise belongs to God who appointed among those roads His month, the month of Ramadan, the month of fasting, the month of submission, the month of purity, the month of putting to test, the month of standing in prayer, "in which the Qur'an was sent down as guidance to the people,

arabic_text: وَبَيِّنَات مِنَ الْهُدى وَالْفُرْقَانِ،
transliteration: wa bayyināt min al-hudá wal-furqān
english_text: and as clear signs of the Guidance and the Separator" (2:185)!

arabic_text: فَأَبَانَ فَضِيْلَتَهُ عَلَى سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ بِمَا جَعَلَ لَهُ مِنَ الْحُرُمَاتِ الْمَوْفُورَةِ وَالْفَضَائِلِ الْمَشْهُورَةِ، فَحَرَّمَ فِيْهِ ما أَحَلَّ فِي غَيْرِهِ إعْظَاماً، وَحَجَرَ فِيْهِ الْمَطَاعِمَ وَالْمَشَارِبَ إكْرَاماً،
transliteration: fa'ābāna faḍīlatuhu ʿalá sā'iri al-shuhūrِ bima jaʿala lahu min al-ḥurumāt al-mawfūrati wal-faḍāʾili al-mashhūrati fa harrama feehi ma aḥalla fe ghayrihi iʿẓaman wa ḥajara fīhi al-maṭāʿim wa al-mashārib ikraman
english_text: He clarified its excellence over other months by the many sacred things and well-known excellencies which He placed therein, for He made unlawful in it what He declared lawful in others to magnify it, He prohibited foods and drinks in it to honour it,

arabic_text: وَجَعَلَ لَهُ وَقْتاً بَيِّناً لاَ يُجِيزُ جَلَّ وَعَزَّ أَنْ يُقَدَّمَ قَبْلَهُ، وَلا يَقْبَـلُ أَنْ يُؤَخَّرَ عَنْهُ،
transliteration: wa jaʿala lahu waqtan bayyinan la yujiz jalla wa'azza an yuqaddama qablahu walā yaqbālu an yuʾakhkhara ʿanhū
english_text: and He appointed for it a clear time which He (majestic and mighty is He) allows not to be set forward and accepts not to be placed behind.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ فَضَّلَ لَيْلَةً وَاحِدَةً مِنْ لَيَالِيهِ عَلَى لَيَالِي أَلْفِ شَهْر، وَسَمَّاهَا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ،
transliteration: thumma faddala laylatan wahidatan min layalihi ʿala layali alfi shahr wa samma-haa laylat al-qadr
english_text: Then He made one of its nights surpass the nights of a thousand months and named it the Night of Decree;

arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْر، سَلاَمٌ دَائِمُ الْبَرَكَةِ إلَى طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ، عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ بِمَا أَحْكَمَ مِنْ قَضَائِهِ.
transliteration: tanazzalu al-malā'ikatu wal-rūḥu fīhā bi-idhni rabbihim min kulli amr salāmun dāʾim al-barakah ilā ṭulūʿ al-fajr ʿalā man yashāʾu min ʿibādihī bimā aḥkama min qaḍāʾihī
english_text: "in it the angels and the Spirit descend by the leave of their Lord upon every command, a peace" (97:4-5) constant in blessings until the rising of the dawn upon whomsoever He will of His servants according to the decision He has made firm.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَعْرِفَةَ فَضْلِهِ وَإِجْلاَلَ حُرْمَتِهِ وَالتَّحَفُّظَ مِمَّا حَظَرْتَ فِيهِ وَأَعِنَّـا عَلَى صِيَامِـهِ بِكَفِّ الْجَـوَارِحِ عَنْ مَعَاصِيْكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa alhimnā maʿrifata faḍlihi wa ij'lāla ḥurmatihi wa al-taḥaffuẓa mimma ḥaẓarta fiih wa'a'innā 'alā ṣiyāmihi bikaffi aljawāriḥi 'an ma'āṣīk
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, inspire us with knowledge of its excellence, veneration of its inviolability, and caution against what Thou hast forbidden within it, and help us to fast in it by our restraining our limbs from acts of disobedience toward Thee

arabic_text: وَاسْتِعْمَالِهَا فِيهِ بِمَا يُرْضِيْكَ حَتَّى لاَ نُصْغِىَ بِأَسْمَاعِنَا إلَى لَغْو، وَلا نُسْرِعَ بِأَبْصَارِنَا إلَى لَهْو، وَحَتَّى لاَ نَبْسُطَ أَيْدِيَنَا إلَى مَحْظُور،
transliteration: waistiʿmaalihā fīhi bimā yurḍīka ḥattá lā nuṣghiyá bi'asmāʿinā 'ilá laghw wala nusriʿa bi-abṣārinā ilā lahwi wa-ḥattá lā nabṣuṭa ʾaydīnā ʾilá maḥẓūr
english_text: and our employing them in that which pleases Thee, so that we lend not our ears to idle talk and hurry not with our eyes to diversion, we stretch not our hands toward the forbidden

arabic_text: وَلاَ نَخْطُوَ بِأَقْدَامِنَا إلَى مَحْجُور، وَحَتَّى لاَ تَعِيَ بُطُونُنَا إلاَّ مَا أَحْلَلْتَ، وَلا تَنْطِقَ أَلْسِنَتُنَا إلاَّ بِمَا مَثَّلْتَ وَلا نَتَكَلَّفَ إلاَّ ما يُدْنِي مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ،
transliteration: walā nakhtuwa bi-aqdamina ilā maḥjūr wa-ḥattá lā taʿiya buṭūnunā ʾillā mā aḥlaltá walā tanṭiq alsinatunā illā bimā mathhalt walā natakallafu illā mā yudnī min thawābika
english_text: and stride not with our feet toward the prohibited, our bellies hold only what Thou hast made lawful and our tongues speak only what Thou hast exemplified, we undertake nothing but what brings close to Thy reward

arabic_text: وَلاَ نَتَعَاطَى إلاّ الَّذِي يَقِيْ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ،
transliteration: walā nataʿāṭā illā alladhī yaqī min ʿiqābika
english_text: and pursue nothing but what protects from Thy punishment!

arabic_text: ثُمَّ خَلِّصْ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ مِنْ رِئآءِ الْمُرَائِينَ وَسُمْعَةِ الْمُسْمِعِينَ، لاَ نَشْرَكُ فِيهِ أَحَداً دُونَكَ، وَلا نَبْتَغِيْ فِيهِ مُرَاداً سِوَاكَ.
transliteration: thumma khalliṣ dhālika kullahu min riʾā'i-l-murā'īna wa suhmaṭi-l-musmiʿīna lā našraku fīhi ʾaḥadan dūnaka walā nabtaghī fīhi murādan siwāka
english_text: Then rid all of that from the false show of the false showers and the fame seeking of the fame seekers, lest we associate therein anything with Thee or seek therein any object of desire but Thee!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَقِفْنَـا فِيْـهِ عَلَى مَـوَاقِيْتِ الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْس بِحُدُودِهَا الَّتِي حَدَّدْتَ، وَفُرُوضِهَا الَّتِي فَرَضْتَ وَوَظَائِفِهَا الَّتِي وَظَّفْتَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa qifnā fīhi ʿalā mawāqīt al-ṣalawāti al-khams bi-ḥudūdihā allatī ḥaddadta wa furūḍihā allatī faraḍta wa waẓāʾifihā allatī waẓẓafta
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, in it make us attend to the appointed moments of the five prayers within the bounds Thou hast set, the obligations Thou hast decreed, the duties Thou hast assigned,

arabic_text: وَأَوْقَاتِهَا الَّتِي وَقَّتَّ،
transliteration: wa-awqātiha allatī waqqata
english_text: and the times Thou hast specified;

arabic_text: وَأَنْزِلْنَا فِيهَا مَنْزِلَةَ الْمُصِيْبينَ لِمَنَازِلِهَا الْحَافِظِينَ لاِرْكَانِهَا الْمُؤَدِّينَ لَهَـا فِي أَوْقَاتِهَـا عَلَى مَا سَنَّـهُ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُـولُكَ صَلَوَاتُـكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِـهِ فِي رُكُوعِهَا وَسُجُودِهَا وَجَمِيْعِ فَوَاضِلِهَا
transliteration: wa anzilna fiha manzilatal musibeen limanaziliha al-ḥāfiẓīna lār-kānihā al-mu'addīna lahā fī awqātiha ʿalā mā sannahu ʿabduka wa rasūluka ṣalawātuka ʿalayhi wa ālihi fī rukuʿiha wa sujūdiha wa jamīʿi fawāḍiliha
english_text: and in the prayers make us alight in the station of the keepers of their stations, the guardians of their pillars, their performers in their times, as Thy servant and Thy messenger set down in his Sunna (Thy blessings be upon him and his Household) in their bowings, their prostrations, and all their excellent acts,

arabic_text: عَلى أَتَمِّ الطَّهُورِ، وَأَسْبَغِهِ وَأَبْيَنِ الْخُشُوعِ وَأَبْلَغِهِ،
transliteration: ʿalā atamm al-ṭahūr, wa-asbaghihi wa-abyani al-khushūʿ wa-ablaghihi
english_text: with the most complete and ample ritual purity and the most evident and intense humility!

arabic_text: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِيهِ لاِنْ نَصِلَ أَرْحَامَنَا بِالبِرِّ وَالصِّلَةِ وَأَنْ نَتَعَاهَدَ جِيرَانَنَابِالاِفْضَالِ وَالْعَطِيَّةِ وَأَنْ نُخَلِّصَ أَمْوَالَنَا مِنَ التَّبِعَاتِ، وَأَنْ نُطَهِّرَهَا بِإخْرَاجِ الزَّكَوَاتِ،
transliteration: wa waffiqnā fīhi lā nasila arḥāmanā bilbirri walṣilati wa'an nata'ahadu jiraananabil-afdaali wal-'atiyyah wa annukhallas amwalana minat-tabi'at wa annuṭahhirahā bi’ikhrāji alzakawāti
english_text: Give us success in this month to tighten our bonds of kin with devotion and gifts, attend to our neighbours with bestowal and giving, rid our possessions from claims, purify them through paying the alms,

arabic_text: وَأَنْ نُرَاجِعَ مَنْ هَاجَرَنَـا وَأَنْ نُنْصِفَ مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا وَأَنْ نُسَـالِمَ مَنْ عَادَانَا حَاشَا مَنْ عُودِيَ فِيْكَ وَلَكَ،
transliteration: wa anna nurājiʿa man hājaranā wa annunṣifa man ẓalamnā wa'an nusālima man 'ādānā ḥāshā man ʿūdiya fīka walaka
english_text: go back to him who has gone far from us, treat justly him who has wronged us, make peace with him who shows enmity toward us (except him who is regarded as an enemy in Thee and for Thee,

arabic_text: فَإنَّهُ الْعَدُوُّ الَّذِي لاَ نُوالِيهِ، وَالحِزْبُ الَّذِي لاَ نُصَافِيهِ.
transliteration: fa'inna hu al-'aduwwu alladhi la nūwālihi wal-ḥizbu al-laḏī lā nuṣāfīhi
english_text: for he is the enemy whom we will not befriend, the party whom we will not hold dear),

arabic_text: وَأَنْ نَتَقَرَّبَ إلَيْكَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ الزَّاكِيَةِ بِمَا تُطَهِّرُنا بِهِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ، وَتَعْصِمُنَا فِيهِ مِمَّا نَسْتَأنِفُ مِنَ الْعُيُوبِ، حَتَّى لا يُورِدَ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ مَلاَئِكَتِكَ إلاّ دُونَ مَا نُورِدُ مِنْ أَبْوابِ الطَّاعَةِ لَكَ، وَأَنْوَاعِ القُرْبَةِ إلَيْكَ.
transliteration: wa an nataqarraba ilayka feehi min al-a'mali al-zakiyati bima tutahhiruna bihi min al-dhunubi wa taʿṣimunā fīhi mimmā nastaʾniʾfu min al-ʿuyūb ḥattá lā yūrida ʿalayka ʾaḥadun min malāʾikatika 'illā dūna mā nūridu min abwābi al-ṭā'ati laka, wa anwāi al-qurbati ilayka
english_text: and seek nearness to Thee through blameless works which will purify us from sins and preserve us from renewing faults, so that none of Thy angels will bring for Thee the kinds of obedience and sorts of nearness-seeking unless they be less than what we bring!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ، وَبِحَقِّ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ فِيهِ مِنِ ابْتِدَائِهِ إلَى وَقْتِ فَنَائِهِ مِنْ مَلَك قَرَّبْتَهُ أَوْ نَبِيٍّ أَرْسَلْتَهُ
transliteration: allāhumma innī as'aluka biḥaqqi hādhā al-shahr wa bi-ḥaqqi man taʿabbada laka fīh min ibtidāʾihi ilā waqti fanaʾihi min malak qarabtahu aw nabiyyin arsaltahu
english_text: O God, I ask Thee by the right of this month and by the right of him who worships Thee within it from its beginning to the time of its passing, whether angel Thou hast brought nigh to Thee, prophet Thou hast sent,

arabic_text: أَوْ عَبْد صَالِح اخْتَصَصْتَهُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَهِّلْنَا فِيهِ لِمَا وَعَدْتَ أَوْلِياءَكَ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ، وَأَوْجِبْ لَنَا فِيهِ مَا أَوْجَبْتَ لأِهْلِ الْمُبَالَغَةِ فِي طَاعَتِكَ،
transliteration: aw 'abd ṣāliḥ akhtasshatahu an tuṣalliya ʿalā muḥammad wa ʾālih wa ahhilna feehi lima wa'adt(a) awliyaa'aka min karaamatika wa-'awjib lana fihi ma 'awjabta li-ahlil mubalaghah fi ta'atika
english_text: or righteous servant Thou hast singled out, that Thou bless Muhammad and his Household, make us worthy of the generosity Thou hast promised Thy friends, make incumbent for us what Thou hast made incumbent for those who go to great lengths in obeying Thee,

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنَا فِي نَظْمِ مَنِ اسْتَحَقَّ الرَّفِيْعَ الأعْلَى بِرَحْمَتِكَ.
transliteration: wa-jaʿlnā fī naẓmi mani istaḥaqqa al-rafiʿa al-aʿlā bi-raḥmatika
english_text: and place us in the ranks of those who deserve through Thy mercy the highest elevation!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَجَنِّبْنَا الإلْحَادَ فِي تَوْحِيدِكَ وَالتَّقْصِيرَ فِي تَمْجِيدِكَ وَالشَّكَّ فِي دِينِـكَ وَالْعَمَى عَنْ سَبِيْلِكَ وَالاغْفَالَ لِحُرْمَتِكَ، وَالانْخِدَاعَ لِعَدُوِّكَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa jannibna al-ilhada fi tawhīdika wa al-taqṣīra fi tamjīdika wal-shakka fī dīnik wa al-ʿamā ʿan sabīlik wa al-aġfāla li-ħurmatik wa-al-inkhida'a li-'aduwwika ash-shaytan ar-rajeem
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, turn us aside from deviation in professing Thy Unity, falling short in magnifying Thee, uncertainty in Thy religion, blindness toward Thy path, heedlessness of Thy inviolability, and being deceived by Thy enemy, the accursed Satan!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَإذَا كَانَ لَكَ فِيْ كُلِّ لَيْلَة مِنْ لَيَالِيْ شَهْرِنَا هَذَا رِقَابٌ يُعْتِقُهَا عَفْوُكَ أَوْ يَهَبُهَا صَفْحُكَ فَاجْعَلْ رِقَابَنَا مِنْ تِلْكَ الرِّقَابِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa 'idha kāna laka fī kulli laylatin min layāli shahrinā hādhā riqābun yuʿtiqūhā ʿafwuka aw yahabuhā ṣafḥuka fajʿal riqaabanā min tilka al-riqaab
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, and when in every night of this month's nights Thou hast necks which Thy pardon will release and Thy forgiveness disregard, place our necks among those necks

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنَا لِشَهْرِنَا مِنْ خَيْرِ أَهْل وَأَصْحَاب.
transliteration: wa-jaʿalnā li-shahrinā min khayri ahl wa-aṣḥāb
english_text: and place us among the best folk and companions of this our month!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَامْحَقْ ذُنُوبَنَا مَعَ امِّحاقِ هِلاَلِهِ وَاسْلَخْ عَنَّا تَبِعَاتِنَا مَعَ انْسِلاَخِ أَيَّامِهِ حَتَّى يَنْقَضِي عَنَّا وَقَدْ صَفَّيْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْخَطِيئاتِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī waamhaq dhunoobana ma'a ammihaaqi hilalih wa aslakh 'anna tabi'atina ma'an-silakh 'ayyamih ḥattá yanqaḍi ʿannā waqad ṣaffaytanā fīhi minal-khaṭīʾāt
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, efface our sins along with the effacing of its crescent moon, and make us pass forth from the ill effects of our acts with the passing of its days, until it leaves us behind, while within it Thou hast purified us of offenses

arabic_text: وَأَخْلَصْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ.
transliteration: wa akhlas-tana fihi mina as-sayyi'at
english_text: and rid us of evil deeds!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَإنْ مِلْنَا فِيهِ فَعَدِّلْنا، وَإنْ زِغْنَا فِيهِ فَقَوِّمْنَا،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa in milnā fīhi faʿaddilnā, wa in zighnā fīhi faqawwimnā
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, and should we go off to one side in this month, set us aright; should we swerve, point us straight;
